subject.title: fix(gateway): retain verified owner authority for OpenAI HTTP

question: Does the existing canonical resolver provide the intended owner-authority contract for both OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoints, including trusted-proxy and shared-secret modes?
rationale: This patch affects the authorization fact that enables owner-only tools; only maintainers can confirm that the intended trust policy and upgrade behavior match the project’s security boundary.

options.title: Confirm canonical resolver contract
options.body: Review the resolver and endpoint call paths, then accept this narrow propagation fix if verified-owner semantics are identical to other Gateway transports.

options.title: Narrow or change the authority policy
options.body: Request a revised implementation if one HTTP authentication mode should remain non-owner even when the generic resolver returns owner authority.
